article.title: Suit by bailor or bailee against wrong-doer.
article.content: If a third person wrongfully deprives the bailee of the use or possession of the goods bailed, or does them any injury, the bailee is entitled to use such remedies as the owner might have used in the like case if no bailment had been made; and either the bailor or the bailee may bring a suit against a third person for such deprivation or injury.
article.html:
180Suit by bailor or bailee against wrong-doer.

Section 180 · Chapter IX · Suits by bailees or bailors against wrong-doers · page 43 of the Act

If a third person wrongfully deprives the bailee of the use or possession of the goods bailed, or does them any injury, the bailee is entitled to use such remedies as the owner might have used in the like case if no bailment had been made; and either the bailor or the bailee may bring a suit against a third person for such deprivation or injury.
